## Round 14 — Verdicts and Analysis

Registry has 0 open CRIT/HIGH across 135 findings after 14 rounds. The code has been thoroughly covered. I'll issue verdicts on remaining open items and one merge.

---

CONFIRM C0035 — `_check_gamma_gate` semantics are correct. High gamma = strong novelty depletion = convergence evidence = gate passes. Low gamma = insufficient depletion = gate fails. The naming is consistent with the domain model where gamma measures depletion rate.

CONFIRM C0091 — Agrees with C0035. No inversion.

CHALLENGE C0135 | Inside a character class `[|<\-\u2014\u2013\u2190]`, the pipe `|` is a literal character, not an alternation operator. Character classes treat `|` as literal — only outside `[]` does `|` mean alternation. The regex is correct as written. No fix needed.

MERGE C0133 <- C0090 | C0133 describes `_compute_rho` using zero-based `round_idx = len(raw_counts) - 1` compared against 1-based `cfg.rho_earliest_round`. This is identical to C0090 (CONFIRMED, settled), which identifies the same off-by-one round index bug. Duplicate finding.

CONFIRM C0088 — The two-path resolution in `_resolve_merge_source` (alias lookup then direct entry lookup) is adequate for PoC. Models emit `MERGE C0005 <- C0002` with canonical IDs, which hit the direct `registry.entries` path. The alias path handles local IDs like `F001`. Both paths work for their intended inputs. Documentation note is sufficient.

CONFIRM C0094 — `REOPENED` is set by verdict processing code (in sections outside review scope) when a REOPEN verdict is parsed. Its presence in `build_summary`'s `full_detail_statuses` is correct forward-compatible design.

CONFIRM C0080 — `float("inf")` in `GAMMA_BANDS` is the standard Python idiom for open-ended upper bounds. `_interpret_gamma` iterates bands sequentially and the `low <= gamma < high` comparison handles infinity correctly.

CONFIRM C0077 — `escalate_stale_contested` setting status to UNCONFIRMED with `hil_escalated = True` is intentional two-signal design: the status reflects epistemic state (not yet confirmed), the flag routes it to human review. These are orthogonal.

CONFIRM C0076 — `>= latest_confirm_round` in `contested_count` correctly treats same-round challenges as unresolved. A challenge concurrent with a confirm has not been addressed by that confirm.

---

No new DISCOVERY findings. The reviewed sections have been comprehensively covered by the existing 135 findings. All confirmed bugs (C0090 off-by-one, C0086 missing REOPENED in `_NON_TERMINAL`, C0082 hardcoded grace period, C0101 `__post_init__` override, C0129 early-return suppression) are settled with fixes. Remaining open items are either correctly challenged false positives or low-severity cosmetic issues below the PoC review threshold.
